title: Filolial Regular Meeting [Part 2]
paragraphs: “Yeah, it’s the same for me. I’ve got a slightly taller one. Their responses seem more mature too.”
“So, Naofumi, you had some too? What about Motoyasu?”
“Filolials are all equally adorable angels.”
Ren and Itsuki are giving me half-lidded stares.
What is it? Do they have some complaints about Filolials?
“I’ll report on Motoyasu’s behalf. The ones he’s taking care of all have the appearance of young girls and boys.”
“What’s causing this difference?”
“Hmm… It seems that the taller ones tend to have higher comprehension or leadership abilities. They often try to lead the others.”
Ren and Itsuki nodded, apparently convinced by Father’s analysis.

“I was worried I wouldn’t be able to manage them all as their numbers grew, but the Filolials that looked older were able to understand my instructions, making battles easier. Of course, Kou and Sakura were still superior in that regard.”
“You could call it leadership. But in my case, maybe because Éclair was giving the instructions, they seemed more like they were mimicking and assisting her.”
“How about you, Father?”
“A few of them helped out in a supportive role. Overall, I’d say about ten percent of them grew taller? It seems more common in the ones with a stronger sense of responsibility.”
Oh, so Filolials show all kinds of differences depending on their environment. This is very educational.
“According to the breeder, it’s a basic rule to give racing Filolials speed-enhancing food early on.”
“By the way… Naofumi, Ren and I noticed something.”
“If you have any useful information, let me know.”
Itsuki raised his hand.
What is it?
“The Filolials that Ren and I are taking care of… we noticed something about their eye color.”
“What’s that?”
“…It might be a coincidence, but there are a few with the same eye color. Of course, many of them also have eyes matching their fur color.”
“Would it be best to analyze them as relatives? There’s definitely some skewed distribution.”
Oh? Father’s conversation with them triggered a memory.
“Father, come to think of it, when I first bought Sakura-chan, her eye color was different in the next loop.”
That’s right. When I registered Sakura-chan, her eyes were sakura-colored, but when Father registered her, her eyes turned blue.
“That’s something you’d only notice after looping. Does the master registered with the monster crest also affect it?”
“Wait… I think the breeder mentioned something similar when I talked to them. Something about needing talent to become a Filolial race breeder… Maybe this is what they were referring to?”
Father flipped through the documents he had received from the Filolial breeders. He quickly skimmed through them. After finding the relevant information, Father showed it to us.
“There it is! A divergence experiment where nearly identical sibling Filolials were raised by different masters. The results show slight differences.”
“When you think about it, since Filolials raised by heroes undergo special growth, it’s only natural that the master they are registered with would cause changes.”
“Yeah… but if that’s the case, maybe Motoyasu getting that Filolial named Filo is…”
Ren stopped speaking midway.
What is it? Are you saying it’s impossible?
I will never give up!

“Motoyasu, you’re not planning to give up either, right? For now, we’re conducting investigations centered around Melromarc, and we’re also considering the possibility that this Filo might be born through a specific method of raising.”
“She’s similar to Sakura… but her color and personality are completely different…”
“Come to think of it, Naofumi. A lot of Filolials have undergone angel transformation, but are there any whose hair color differs from their feather color as Filolials?”
Ren asked Father. Father furrowed his brows as if troubled by the question and looked toward Itsuki and me. Itsuki shook his head.
“Unfortunately, none of the Filolials I raised had different hair colors from their feathers when they transformed into angel form.”
That’s right. It’s the same for me. Thinking about it now, Filo was a unique existence who possessed characteristics that no other Filolial had. This is eye-opening.
Filo being a treasure is beyond doubt. This is proof of that!
“Motoyasu looks like he’s having an epiphany, staring off into the distance. What should we do? Could there be some unseen condition standing in our way?”
“Maybe… If we don’t understand the condition that changes the Filolial’s hair color in angel form, even if we find this Filo, she might not become the same.”
At that point, Father murmured something softly.
“…Maybe if Sakura-chan met that condition, she’d become this Filo…”
I heard that.
No! Sakura-chan is Sakura-chan! She’s not Filo!
“Hey, Motoyasu. In all the loops so far, have you ever seen a Filolial whose hair color was different in its angel form?”
“Can Motoyasu’s memory really help here?”
“When it comes to Filolials, he even remembers their scent. He might have noticed something.”
As Father spoke, I was already thinking about Filo.
Ah, Filo… where are you? Did Father raise Filo so carefully because she was destined to take on a different form than other Filolials? Father created Filo as the only angel of her kind in the world.
Filo was a rare breed! While feeling deeply moved, I was reflecting on the question Father had asked.

Among all the Filolials I’ve encountered, was there ever a Filolial whose angel form had a different hair color from its Filolial form…? Her stature was just like Yuki and the others, with a youthful appearance. Eyes as deep as the night sea, a shimmering silver color. Glistening as if absorbing the sunlight. Her appearance was distinctly different from any Filolial I had seen before.
I remember now! Yes, a Filolial who had an extraordinary passion for Keel! One who would usually end a conversation with just a word or two…
At that time, Father had been puzzled about her hair color!
“Luna-chan was like that!”
“Oh, there was one? A Filolial whose color was different?”
“Yes, there was!”
“So? What kind of child was she, and where did you get her?”

“She was one of the eggs that Father bought when he forced the monster merchant in Melromarc to deal only in Filolial eggs! For some reason, when she transformed into her angel form, her hair color changed.”
“When was this?”
“Around the time when Father purchased Filo. It was after we overcame the first wave in Melromarc.”
At that, Father and the others fell silent. It’s certainly a mystery why only Filo and Luna turned out that way.
“Could it be related to the stars or something?”
“If it’s about the phases of the moon, we’d need a fortune teller to figure that out.”
“It’s getting more confusing… If it’s about their diet, we’d have to feed them something unusual… Did anything stand out?”
“Was there anything unusual? We fed them the same food as the others.”
“Judging by the children Motoyasu raised, could it be a dietary difference? Hmm… I’m not sure.”
Father and the others were deep in thought.
“For now, when we return from Cal Mira Island, wouldn’t it be best if Motoyasu procured that Luna’s egg? You can tell by the scent, right?”
“I remember the scent! She loved cute things.”
“Huh. So she liked cute things, huh.”
“Filolials really do have a lot of different personalities.”
“Indeed. They’re far too complex… Well, just like humans, they’re all unique.”
Father, Ren, and Itsuki all seemed exhausted. I was deeply moved by how much they had investigated.
“For now, while we’re on the island, let’s continue raising the Filolials properly. It should make things easier when the next wave hits.”
“…Yeah. Let’s raise them with that in mind.”
“If different food yields different results, that’s quite intriguing. I’d like to speak with the breeder. Let’s visit them later.”

And so, the meeting came to an end. The number of Filolials is steadily increasing. I slept peacefully in the paradise that Father had prepared —a ship just for the Filolials. I miss the Filolial ranch from the first world. When I think about it, I remember so many of the children from that ranch. Thus, another shining night passed on Cal Mira Island. Come to think of it, Kuu, Marin, and Midori were also there, but they seemed somewhat quieter than usual. As Father predicted, the environment might be causing some changes. When I reported this to Father, he took notes, saying he’d use it as a reference.
“It seems that environment does indeed influence personality to some extent.”
That was the impression I was left with.
Chapter 709 – Soup
And so, the days on Cal Mira Island passed by.
“I got this kind of costume.”
“…I have this one.”
“As for me—”

Father and the others were comparing the drops from the island bosses and discussing the costumes. Father had a Pengoo costume, Ren had a Dog costume, Itsuki had a Squirrel costume, and I had a Rabbit costume.
“These kinds of joke equipment actually have surprisingly high stats.”
“I’m never wearing this. And why is Naofumi wearing it without hesitation!?”
“It looked fun, and honestly, this thing’s performance isn’t something to underestimate. It was fun swimming with Gaelion-chan and the Filolials.”
“Hmph! It’s not my style.”
“The Squirrel costume seems to have tree-climbing skills…”
“That might be good for Itsuki. Climbing a tree and sniping! Attacking from a one-sided advantage.”
“You expect me to fight in this joke equipment!?”
“Sometimes it might be necessary, you know?”
“No way!”
“Should I consider wearing the Rabbit costume myself?”
It increases speed. But the visibility is a bit poor. If anything, I would have preferred a Filolial costume.
“Maybe it’s a matter of taste? You could ask the castle’s blacksmiths if they can extract the effects separately.”
“I’d rather not use it if possible…”
“Yeah, fighting in this kind of joke equipment is just too much. It feels like we’re not even heroes anymore.”
“Why do we have to be the ones wearing it?”

At that, Father glanced toward Éclair, the assistants, and the mole. By the way, since this is considered monster equipment, it doesn’t work on the Filolials. Éclair, feeling the gaze, flinched and turned to face Father. She seemed to strongly dislike the idea.
“Iwatani-dono, you don’t mean to suggest that we should wear that, do you?”
“Depending on the situation, it might be safer if you did.”
Father answered calmly, and Éclair gripped the hilt of her short sword as if ready to set off immediately. She really didn’t like the idea.
“Windia-dono, Imia-dono, let’s go level up! If we don’t, we might be forced to wear those!”
“You hate it that much?”
“Of course I do. That’s basically a punishment game!”
Huh? Am I remembering wrong? I seem to recall Itsuki making one of his companions wear something like that…
Ah, yes, the stalker pig.
“Heroes, once we’ve leveled up, make sure to enhance our abilities!”
“Eh? Ah… yeah. Sure, I’ll do that.”

And with that, Éclair quickly headed off for hunting. The assistants and the mole had also improved their combat abilities considerably. Even though they were originally in charge of magic, they’re doing their best. By the time we had finished our respective hunts, the sun was beginning to set. As usual, we regrouped and talked for a while before Éclair returned.
“Well then, since Éclair is back from hunting, why don’t you relax in the outdoor bath?”
“Hmm, I’ll do that. Iwatani-dono, make sure Imia-dono and Windia-dono don’t switch my clothes with a costume.”
“Do I look like the kind of person who would pull that kind of prank!?”
Father answered Éclair, looking a little offended. However, Ren and Itsuki, with half-lidded eyes, followed up with their own comments aimed at Father.
“He does seem like he’d do it. Usually, he’s relatively sensible, but sometimes he likes to joke around.”
“Yeah. If something like that happened, Naofumi would be the first suspect.”
“No trust at all… Well, whatever. Let’s just relax in the outdoor bath.”
Father replied with a sigh, his shoulders slumping. By the way, the Filolials also come here regularly to bathe.
“Yeah. Honestly, just being able to relax in the hot springs makes coming here worthwhile.”
Father and the others enjoyed their bath time.
Hot springs are the soul of the Japanese!
“How many times have you been to this hot spring, Motoyasu-san?”
Itsuki asked me. I thought back to all the times I had been to Cal Mira Island.
“Let’s see. In the first world, Father got the portal, so we came here almost every day. In other loops, I come when I’m leveling up.”
“I’ve heard that once the activation is complete, you can obtain the portal. It would be nice if we could come here daily…”
“This hot spring apparently works on curses too.”
That’s exactly right. In the first world, Father actually came here to heal his curse.
“It’s quite versatile. And having the portal would be incredibly convenient.”
“With support from the kingdom, we can bathe as much as we want… What a life.”
“At first, even camping out felt so inconvenient… but we’ve changed, haven’t we?”
“Yeah, those first few days were rough.”
As if reminiscing, Father and the others talked about their journey to the hot springs. And then, it was bath time.
“Okay, Eclair-san. I know it’s tough to keep an eye on everyone, but I’ll leave it to you.”
“Ah… Well, it’s not like anyone causes trouble in the bath. Everyone is quiet… or not.”
Éclair glanced over at Rival and Sakura-chan.
“What is it?”
“Hmm?”
They’ve been crossing the boundary and sneaking into the men’s bath every night.
“It’s a hassle on this end too.”
“Motoyasu-sama! Yuki is waiting for you tonight as well.”
“As am I.”
“Ah… yeah. It’s a lot to handle, either way.”
With that, Father and the others headed to the changing room.
And soon after, they stripped down and dashed into the hot spring!
“Motoyasu! I won’t let you peep tonight!”

Ren chased after me, shouting. On the first day, both Ren and Itsuki were on board, but for some reason, lately, they’ve been trying to stop me. Father seemed amused at first, but in the end, it never got to the point of actual peeping. Rather, things got completely out of hand when Sakura-chan and Rival sneaked in.
“Ha ha ha! This is a ritual to elevate the beauty of those being admired!”
“Windia, Imia, if Kitamura-dono tries to peek over the fence, use magic to stop him.”
“Okay.”
“Ah, yes…”
I can hear Éclair’s voice.
But it’s useless!
“Come on, Kou, be my stepping stone!”
“Eh… Iwatani’s gonna get mad, so no…”
Hmm, even Kou is feeling down.
Everyone’s enthusiasm is lacking!
“That’s what happens when you try to peep every day.”
“Then, should I ask another Filolial to help?”
“Damn… there are too many who’d willingly help!”
“This is another side effect of raising Filolials, huh.”
Ren and Itsuki groaned.
Indeed. They should give up this futile resistance already.
“Ha ha ha! Ren, Itsuki, just enjoy the view of everyone’s bare skin for the sake of your eyes!”
“Nano! Gaelion wants Naofumi to look at her and be charmed, nano!”
“Not happening!”
Rival and Sakura-chan were trying to push each other while attempting to climb over the fence.
“Hey! You’re not going there tonight!”
“Gaelion! Don’t do that!”
“The more obstacles, the more it fires me up, nano!”
Ren and Itsuki let out exhausted sighs at the commotion.
“…The women’s bath is just as chaotic.”
“Yeah. Naofumi, why don’t you just bathe at a different time?”
“If I go alone to the men’s bath, won’t those two barge in after me!?”
“Isn’t that fine? They’re Naofumi-san’s heroines, after all.”
“Is that how you see them, Itsuki? They’re just kids! There’s no way I’d lay a hand on them!”
Father spoke, sounding offended.
That’s right, I won’t let Rival take Father away!
“After hearing about Kou’s marriage talks, you’re still saying that?”
“Exactly. Even if they look like that, they’re still non-human.”
“Geez…”
Father pressed his fingers against his forehead, looking exasperated.
“While they’re distracted, I’ll use my physical prowess to lean on the fence and take a peek!”
“Ah, Motoyasu!”
“I won’t let you!”
Just as I was about to witness paradise beyond the fence, a very familiar wall appeared before my eyes.
This is…!
“Air Strike Shield.”
“Nice one, Naofumi!”
Father is blocking me!?
But I won’t give up!
